summary: ci(circleci): benchmark workspace vs nx remote cache hand-off
description:
Because:

- We want to measure whether a Build workspace beats per-job installs plus the nx remote cache

This commit:

- Runs Build first again, installing dependencies itself, with all test jobs requiring it
- Adds a pr_handoff pipeline parameter: install (default) or workspace
- Saves .nx/workspace-data and root dist in the build workspace so nx can hit locally
- Records nx profiles in Build, test and functional-test steps
